response.original_title: {Cabin~Upgrade™ Guide} How Do I Upgrade Your Carnival Cruise Cabin After Booking?
response.overview: You can upgrade your room on a Carnival cruise 1 (877) 435-9057 online through your booking dashboard, by using the Post Booking Sales page, or by calling  1 (877) 435-9057 Carnival customer service or your travel agent.  Call Carnival or Your Travel Agent: 1 (877) 435-9057 You can directly call Carnival customer service 1 (877) 435-9057 or your personal vacation planner (PVP) to pay the difference between your current fare and a higher cabin category. If you booked through a travel agent, they can check for "Be the Hero" upgrade options or call on your behalf.
